'''Energy Hub''' is an area of [[Tethys' Deep]], [[The Black Shores]]. It houses a KU-Roro charging station, where KU-Roros (aka Tethys Terminals) return to recharge and "rest" when their energy reserves run low.<ref>[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main/news/detail/1474 Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2]</ref>
